articles.title: Blood Clots and Buried Science: What the Medical Establishment Refused to Tell You

articles.title: Why Weren't We Warned? The Institutional Silence That Killed Informed Consent

The piece challenges why regulators and media suppressed safety signals that were visible to independent researchers. This is not incompetence; it is a policy of silence.

articles.title: Vaccinating Surgical Patients: The Ethical Atrocity Being Normalized in Hospital Wards

Baker, MD, tears apart the practice of 'perioperative vaccination' — administering vaccines to patients in the perioperative window when immune systems are compromised and informed consent is most vulnerable. Baker argues this practice violates foundational medical ethics and exposes patients to compounded risks that are never disclosed. The fact that this is being normalized without outcry from medical boards is itself the scandal.

articles.title: Vitamin D Research the Mainstream Won't Amplify: What the 2024 International Forum Actually Found

articles.title: Texas Children's Hospital Forced to Open Detransition Clinic After $10M Settlement — The Medical Scandal They Hoped Would Stay Quiet

articles.title: ENO2-Driven Glycolysis in Liver Cancer: Metabolic Research That Challenges the Standard Oncology Playbook
